title: Microsoft 365 Backup: activity logs for policy and restore operations
summary: The briefing is held because its admin-centre route omits Settings, the documented navigation step needed to open Microsoft 365 Backup. The activity-log behaviour, retention, permissions and consumption pricing are supported; the overview and pricing pages use different storage units and should both be reported.
